criteria.deficiency: JSON renderable hard-codes Text.overflow to "ignore" (generated rich/json.py:22) instead of leaving it None as the reference does (reference rich/json.py:22). Fix: set text.overflow = None (and keep no_wrap = True), and update the overflow assertion in tests/test_json.py.
